claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Chlorphenesin carbamate is a centrally acting muscle relaxant with no annotated anticancer target; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive, with any weak killing likely reflecting nonspecific physicochemical or cationic amphiphilic lysosomal stress rather than a defined mechanism class.
